reason: A local, self-hosted workbench for orchestrating coding-agent tasks through sessions, approval queues, project knowledge persistence, and context assembly.

summaries.zh: 面向个人开发者的本地自托管编码代理工作台，用任务会话、评论审批、项目知识库和上下文装配来管理代理执行。
summaries.en: A local, self-hosted coding-agent workbench that manages execution through task sessions, comment-based approvals, project knowledge, and assembled context.

capabilities: Manages coding tasks as independent agent sessions
Runs a DeepSeek-based coding agent through a Node subprocess
Accepts instructions and approvals through task comments and queues
Persists project knowledge and assembles context for later tasks
Uses a local SQLite-backed service with browser-based project management
